oauth: Google and Kakao both use authorization code, unpredictable state, S256 PKCE and OIDC nonce
Only matching unexpired state, provider and initiating browser may complete; callback consumes state once atomically
Token exchange uses exact configured redirect URI and original code verifier; ID token signature/issuer/audience/expiry/nonce validated before account creation
Provider errors and invalid tokens issue no service session; same email never links identities
access: RS256 with explicit kid; exact 900-second exp minus iat
Current private signing key and old public verification keys coexist during rotation
Forged signature, unknown kid, wrong algorithm, wrong issuer/audience and expired token rejected
JWT verification needs no Redis and expired boundary is exact
refresh: Opaque cryptographic token; raw value absent from Redis keys and stored values
Initial idle 14 days; absolute family expiry 30 days never extended by rotation
Rotation invalidates old token; replay revokes the entire family including most recent token
Concurrent rotation yields at most one success; replay also invalidates any winner token
Current logout preserves another device; all-device logout preserves another account
Concurrent all-device logout and rotation leaves no surviving older family
Redis unavailable or lost never recreates an existing session
http: Refresh cookie Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Path=/api/auth without Domain
Refresh and logout exact configured Origin; missing, null, lookalike and trailing-path origins refused
Refresh raw token only in Set-Cookie, Access only in response body; cookies expire on logout
All-device logout requires authenticated account and does not accept target account input
